notes:
E-Sys MAX 4.9.3

New
- Car report PDF tells the whole visit: when E-Sys connected, the full backup, every fault scan with its codes, the clear and the scan after it, each coding change by name, module restarts and earlier reports, in time order.
- Full backup works quietly: E-Sys's own windows stay out of sight while E-Sys MAX reads the car, and a question that needs you still comes up.
- Full backup also keeps the module list the car stores, a backup log and the car's job history.
- Fault scan in two panes, with a page for each fault.

Changes
- Code several opens its coding help at once, also right after starting.
- A full backup no longer ends "with notes" when every module was read fine.
- The title bar shows only the version and your licence.
- Restart all checks the car before the first module; battery registration needs a voltage first.
- German texts are formal everywhere.
- Cleaner NCD compare and a stronger About page.
- Stronger protection under the hood.

Your licence and settings stay the same after updating.

Thank you for using E-Sys MAX.
